Halfway through, I stood up, put on a weighted vest, and kept reading. … Do you think that even sitting in bed watching TV, the "foot and toe flexing and pointing" I do also help? I have done that since I was in rehab after my bilateral knee replacement surgery. They put this contraption on your leg, a sleeve that points and flexes the toes and moves your leg muscle, insuring blood flow to avoid clots. I decided when I came home to keep it up on my own, without contraption.
